column1: # G12 phase 9: meta(v, ...r) -- the annotation rider
# Value-transparent, on deprecate()'s precedent: the value unifies
# exactly as v, and each record's annotations ride the result through
# meets, reference copies and spread applications. Two riders meet as a
# key-wise union of their value sets, so the meet commutes, repeats to
# itself and never refuses; canon writes the rider after the value, one
# record per layer of values. Generation never sees it.
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md).
# The rider rides into whatever it meets, an any and a check held on a
# container included: a value with nothing to say of its own still says
